fieldNotes.siteIdentity: The roster coordinates (geocoded to 6430 Ballinger Rd, movedMeters 462) landed on the PTI passenger terminal. The actual Honda Aircraft Company world-HQ campus is on the NE side of Piedmont Triad International Airport at ~36.1025, -79.9235 — a large multi-building aircraft assembly complex with an aircraft apron opening onto an airfield taxiway. Confirmed by satellite (a HondaJet business jet visible on the apron) and 2026 Street View showing HONDA signage on the production building. 133-acre campus.
fieldNotes.facilityNature: This is an aircraft ASSEMBLY plant, not a freight/distribution facility. Truck activity is light (inbound parts, supplies); there are no trailer drop yards and only a handful of service dock doors. The dominant 'yard' is the airside aircraft apron, which is not a truck yard.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The campus vehicle entrance road off the public road has a small guard-booth structure with gate hardware, visible in 2026 Street View — a controlled entry consistent with a secured aerospace facility. Classified true.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small staffed booth (1-vehicle footprint) sits at the campus entrance road. Classified true.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a physical guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance road runs a long way through landscaped grounds to the buildings, with ample queuing length.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 0-10 — only a few service/parts dock doors at the production building's landside face; one semi-trailer observed parked there. Honest estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: NONE — no marked trailer drop stalls; this facility does not run a trailer drop operation.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has the main production/assembly complex plus the SW wing-production building and adjacent office buildings — a multi-building campus.
fieldNotes.railServed: False — no rail spur; the facility is served by the airfield, not rail.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — the campus sits at the wooded NE edge of the airport surrounded by woods and open land; 2026 Street View shows a rural two-lane road.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single controlled entry lane at the guard booth; low confidence on exact count.
